summary: John's 2nd cousin 9x removed (Bull → Daniel → Daniel 2d → Caleb); co-heir of Hauppauge.
bio:
Wood credits the 'Caleb place' to Caleb I.

Pelletreau ([R4-S1]) describes him as 'a sturdy patriot' who refused the oath of allegiance to the King during the British occupation, though many kinsmen signed it.
sources: [R4-S1] W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. pp. 476-477, 491 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/recordsoftownofs00smitrich
